concerns.text: The plan cites a verified parquet dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AdityaMayukhSom/MixSub-LLaMA-3.2-Text-Only-Overlap-CPU-Score/.../train-00000-of-00001.parquet and claims it contains scientific pages with *text and layout annotations* (and images for the frozen ResNet‑18 encoder). This dataset, by its name and known content, is a **text‑only** collection for LLaMA‑3.2 and does **not** provide layout bounding boxes or associated page images. Consequently the dataset is inappropriate for FR‑001 (visual latent generation) and will cause the pipeline to fail when attempting to load images or layout data. A suitable replacement should be a dataset that includes both rendered page images and layout annotations, such as PubLayNet, DocBank, or the original llmXive layout‑distillation corpus referenced in the parent project.
